name: MartinGames
description: Video game and console retailer in Uruguay with an online store on the Fenicio platform. Sells PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo consoles, retro games, PC and accessories. States shipping across the country, free above a stated threshold, with interior orders sent by agency.
description_es: Comercio de videojuegos y consolas en Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma Fenicio. Vende consolas PlayStation, Xbox y Nintendo, juegos retro, PC y accesorios. Indica envíos a todo el país, gratis por encima de un monto indicado, con envíos al interior por agencia.

ships_to.notes: States shipping to the whole country; free above a stated threshold. Interior orders by agency; costs below threshold not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Mentions pickup options and two branches; addresses not given on the homepage.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping, free threshold, agency for interior, categories
